_about: Louisa May Alcott's (1832-1888) books for young readers: the March family books (Little Women, Little Men, Jo's Boys), Eight Cousins and Rose in Bloom, An Old-Fashioned Girl, Under the Lilacs, Jack and Jill, and her first book, Flower Fables (1855). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

_excluded.alcott-duplicates: second transcriptions: Little Women (PG 37106), Little Men (PG 52900), Eight Cousins (PG 38567), Rose in Bloom (PG 41127)
_excluded.alcott-other: the Aunt Jo's Scrap-Bag and Lulu's Library volumes, story collections, the thrillers (Behind a Mask and others), Hospital Sketches, Work, Moods: candidates for a later batch
